## Summary

Implementation of F9; satisfies parent AC8.

- [ ] **AC3:** README (if it describes scenes/modules) reflects the new power-ups/ and ui/HUD.ts modules.
- [ ] **AC4:** Code comments in the new modules document intent (lifecycle windows, 3% threshold, refresh semantics, magnet formula).

## Key Files:

- README.md — module/scene list update if present
- src/powerups/*.ts, src/ui/HUD.ts — code comments
